rationale: Salesforce admins and developers are a crisp, well-paid B2B buyer whose work is actively blocked by Workbench outages — this is a real, recurring, team-level pain in contexts where downtime has direct business cost. Willingness to pay is strong: these users already pay for Salesforce licenses at $150–$300/user/month, and tools like Dataloader.io and Validity DemandTools charge $50–$200/month for comparable admin tooling. However, the total hits exactly the build threshold, and while operational_autonomy just clears the gate at 7, buildability is at the minimum floor — a reliable browser-based SOQL/data tool requires Salesforce Connected App setup, OAuth flows, and robust API handling that is achievable but not trivially a one-week Claude-plus-Stripe project. Validate first by offering a waitlist/early access page to Salesforce admin communities and gauging signup rate before committing to build.
solution_plan: The micro-service would be a hosted, browser-based Salesforce query and data tool — a reliable alternative to Workbench — with status monitoring and self-healing reconnection logic. Building it would involve a Claude-assisted backend that handles Salesforce OAuth, proxies SOQL queries, and surfaces results in a clean UI; the factory can generate the prompt logic, landing page, and Stripe payment link, but someone (a freelancer, not Youval directly) would need to wire the Salesforce Connected App authentication flow — this is a one-time setup, not ongoing coding. Selling it means posting to the Salesforce Trailblazer Community, r/salesforce, and LinkedIn groups for Salesforce admins — a natural high-intent channel with 500k+ active members; outreach goes out only after Youval approves it. Once live, delivery is automated: users self-serve OAuth connect their org, queries run via the API, and billing runs via Stripe; support via Claude-handled FAQ with escalation routing. The only recurring human touch is approving new outreach batches and reviewing any escalated support tickets weekly.
notes: operational_autonomy (7) and buildability_with_ai (6) meet build_gate minimums, but total of 6.5 is at the minimum build threshold. Recommended validate stage given zero responsiveness signal and non-trivial OAuth/Salesforce integration complexity. No build_gate failures, but responsiveness_signal=1 warrants validation before committing build resources.
